[[Gloop's Focus]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Gloop]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Ooze Pit]] dungeon.

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Air Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of Air Magic [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30
